rationale: Official Cirrus Insight pages identify Meeting AI within the Cirrus Insight feature family and explicitly describe AI-based pre-meeting research using Salesforce activity and trusted/public sources. The row's Gmail/Salesforce integration is a meaningful conventional core, so AI-enabled is supported if Meeting AI is included. Neither cited page establishes that it was included (rather than a separately purchased add-on) in the source-represented offering, nor when it became available. Under the include-vs-add-on rule, choose weak/forced AI-positive as best-supported product-family call while making the packaging limitation explicit.
ai_type_rationale: Email/CRM integration, calendar and contacts synchronization remain a meaningful core without AI meeting preparation; AI-enabled is the appropriate type if the feature is included.
version_scope: Record is undated and describes Gmail/Salesforce integration. Current Meeting AI/product-feature pages establish product-family AI, but inclusion/packaging and historical applicability to the represented offer are unresolved.
issues: AI feature included versus separately purchased in the represented product tier is unknown.

sources.excerpt: Cirrus Insight's core functionality is to integrate Google's popular Gmail ad-supported free email program with Salesforce.com's cloud-based customer relationship management CRM software. Features include the ability to track Gmail emails and attachments in Salesforce, view Salesforce information in Gmail and other Google Apps, synchronize the Salesforce and Google calendars, and add the user's Google Contacts to Salesforce
sources.applicability: Frozen row identifies conventional Gmail/Salesforce integration but says nothing about Meeting AI inclusion.
